_note: Author labels for the write-up check, held-out set. Written together with the submissions, BEFORE the check was run on any of them. Subjective, one person, pending independent review.

polished_unbacked_numbers.why: Slick but specific; marketing tone without padded stock phrases.

buzzword_pipeline.why: Pure padding in mixed wording: some phrases (seamlessly, transformative, unlock the, the future of) are on the check's list; others (next-generation, empowers, unparalleled, holistic) are not.

rough_but_rigorous.why: Informal and specific, the opposite of padded.
